entities.summary: In database design, object-oriented programming and design, has-a is a composition relationship where one object "belongs to" another object, and behaves according to the rules of ownership. In simple words, has-a relationship in an object is called a member field of an object. Multiple has-a relationships will combine to form a possessive hierarchy.
